rule: Spring tides occur near new moon and full moon
texts: Spring tides occur at new moon.

fields.sentence: Spring tides occur at new moon.

q1_issues.issue: The rule carries the definitional band (STV 1.0 0.99) for a bare-plural empirical generic with no quantifier word, where the dial puts a contingent generalization at strength 0.9 / confidence 0.9 ('when unsure -> empirical').

q2_gaps: a verbal generic over an EVENT-denoting kind whose light verb reifies nothing ('spring tides occur at ...'): the generic-rule form assumes an entity domain plus a Skolem-function event conclusion, while the light-verb rule ('occur / happen / take place' adds no event) is stated only for a specific event-noun witness, so the composition — quantifying over instances of the eventuality kind and putting Time directly on the domain variable — is not addressed
review.notes: The spring_tide genus (noun modifier correctly unexposed) and the refusal to reify a separate 'occur' event both follow the instruction set; omitting a genus for the time symbol new_moon is defensible since the IS-A fails for a time-denoting compound.

issues.reason: A spring tide at full moon is a conceivable counterexample, so the claim is contingent — empirical confidence 0.9, with 'when unsure → empirical' — and a bare generic without all/every takes strength 0.9, making the definitional (STV 1.0 0.99) band unlicensed.

gaps_confirmed: a verbal generic over an event-denoting kind under a light verb ('spring tides occur at ...') — composing the generic-rule machinery (entity domain plus Skolem-event conclusion) with the light-verb no-reification rule (stated only for a specific event-noun witness) is unaddressed
new_gaps: 'at new moon' — a recurring astronomical phase as a temporal adjunct fits no Time category (calendar/clock terms, deictic constants, day-parts); whether it is a bare Time constant, a frequency slot, or something else is unspecified
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is the same rule at (STV 0.9 0.9).
adjudication.notes: Putting Time directly on the domain variable with no reified occur event is graceful improvisation inside the confirmed gap, and suppressing a genus for new_moon is defensible — the phase-as-time is not a moon, per the hot-dog IS-A bar.

fields.sentence: Spring tides occur at full moon.

The minted compound symbol full_moon carries no decomposition atoms — the genus (Inheritance full_moon moon), plus the modifier genus for the predicable adjective 'full', is mandatory for a fused compound, exactly as room_temperature emits (Inheritance room_temperature temperature).

review.notes: The light-verb-over-event-noun rule is applied correctly: no separate 'occur' event is reified and the time rides the spring-tide instance itself.
